name: Chongoni Rock-Art Area
description: High on the forested granite hills of central Malawi, Chongoni holds 127 rock-art sites, the richest collection in Central Africa. Hunter-gatherer BaTwa painters began the tradition in the Stone Age, and Chewa farmers carried it on into the 20th century. The designs are closely tied to women, and the shelters still host Chewa ceremonies and rituals today.
